title: Lease authorization for 57 Jubilee Drive
subtitle: Brief special meeting with in-camera land matters, Indigenous History Month and Pride Month statements, and no delegations.
overview: Kitchener's special Council meeting on June 16, 2025 was short. Council met, agreed to hold a closed session on two potential land disposition matters {{vote:m1}}, and recessed. No delegations were heard, and there was no mayoral business or pecuniary interest disclosed.

When Council returned, it authorized the Chief Administrative Officer to approve and execute agreements for the leased building at 57 Jubilee Drive {{vote:m2}}. The agreements must follow the terms discussed in closed session and satisfy the City Solicitor. This follows report COR-2025-287. Details of those terms were not made public in the minutes.

At the start, the Mayor gave a land acknowledgement and statements marking National Indigenous History Month, National Indigenous Peoples Day on June 21, and Pride Month. The Mayor described the second closed-session item as an affordable housing opportunity, but the minutes record no separate decision on it. Council then passed the confirming by-law and adjourned at 6:28 p.m.

decisions.detail: Council authorized the Chief Administrative Officer to approve and execute agreements for the leased building at 57 Jubilee Drive, on terms discussed in closed session and satisfactory to the City Solicitor.

debate: The transcript records no substantive debate; the lease motion was moved, seconded, and carried after a call for discussion drew none.
No delegations were registered or heard at this meeting.
The Mayor's opening statements urged residents to learn about Indigenous history, support local Indigenous-led organizations, and take part in Pride Month events.
